warning_source: Avigdor Liberman, serving Minister of Defense
recipient: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu; IDF Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot; senior security/cabinet recipients reported
warning_summary: Top-secret 11-page Gaza assessment warned Hamas intended to move the next confrontation into Israel with significant well-trained forces including Nukhba, seize one or more Gaza-envelope communities and take hostages; also warned the border obstacle could not substitute for strategy and Hamas could choose the timing of war.
evidence_state: Ynet 30 Oct 2023 reproduces contemporaneous document excerpts/images and names Netanyahu/Eisenkot among recipients; Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post independently report the document and delivery. Published to Notion as High / Both / Direct documented receipt / Specific.
gaps: Exact contemporaneous cabinet response remains incompletely documented. Liberman's later claim that Netanyahu rejected a preventive operation is preserved as retrospective; response coded Unclear rather than inferred rejection.

warning_source: State Comptroller Yosef Shapira / State Comptroller's Office
recipient: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu; Defense Minister Moshe Ya'alon; IDF Chief of Staff Gadi Eisenkot
warning_summary: Urgent draft audit warned of gaps, some serious, in intelligence, force-building and operational preparedness for Hamas's tunnel threat; later final report substantiated major readiness and Gaza-envelope defense deficiencies.
evidence_state: Walla and Israel Hayom contemporaneously document same-day urgent transfer to named recipients; State Comptroller final 28 Feb 2017 report is primary authoritative corroboration. Published to Notion as High / Both / Direct documented receipt / Moderately specific.
gaps: Government/defense figures said the tunnel threat was already known and being addressed; specific measures caused by the 4 Feb draft cannot be isolated, so response remains Unclear.

warning_source: Yoram Cohen, Director of the Shin Bet
warning_summary: After an offensive Gaza tunnel was discovered inside Israel, Cohen briefed Netanyahu on the cross-border tunnel threat; subsequent Shin Bet and later MI updates continued, and by Nov-Dec 2013 the threat was characterized as strategic.
evidence_state: State Comptroller 2017 official reconstruction establishes the same-day meeting, direct receipt, Netanyahu's detection-method instruction and periodic follow-up; contemporaneous tunnel-discovery reporting corroborates the triggering event. Published to Notion as High / Retrospective public evidence / Direct documented receipt / Moderately specific.
gaps: The public official reconstruction does not reproduce a verbatim contemporaneous meeting note; later updates are attached as continuation evidence rather than counted separately absent distinct delivery records.

warning_source: Yigal Carmon, MEMRI founder and former counterterrorism adviser
recipient: No qualifying named government/security recipient established
warning_summary: Public analysis warned that growing indicators pointed to possible war in September-October 2023, potentially from uncontrolled escalation or unusually deadly new weapons involving Hamas/Hezbollah.
evidence_state: Contemporaneous publication is well documented and unusually time-specific; Iran International and Jerusalem Post later reported the warning.
gaps: No evidence recovered that it was delivered to or read by a named serving government or senior state/security decision-maker before Oct. 7. Public publication alone does not satisfy receipt rule.

recipient: Then-PM Naftali Bennett directly; 2023 current-officeholder inheritance not established
warning_summary: Official follow-up audit documented persistent border-community defense-component and communications gaps, including Southern Command coverage gaps and substantial unmet funding needs; report framed settlement-defense systems as critical against hostile infiltration.
evidence_state: Official State Comptroller page states report was delivered to the prime minister on 15 Feb 2022 and documents findings/recipients.
gaps: Direct recipient in 2022 was not a member of the serving 2023 government. Need proof the findings were repeated/transferred to Netanyahu, Gallant or another qualifying 2023 officeholder, or otherwise inherited through a named decision-maker, before acceptance under older-warning rule.
